name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
label: Quest
description: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were gathering the supplies, I had some of my people handle marking the Scourge buildings we need demolished.

Here's the plan: I'm going to give you ten sticks of my special compound. You're going to take them over to Plaguewood and plant them inside the Scourge structures that I've had marked for detonation.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I got supplies left over to make a few more sticks of the special compound. Just let ol' Smokey know if you need more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're much darker than I remember. You got that look going for you; the look that says, 'I've been charred by a high explosive bomb.'
Anyhow! Here's your cut of the loot. I've thrown in a little something extra to help soothe the burns.
